title: musl cross-compile targets not installed
description: CLAUDE.md Quality Gates requires cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl before every push. However, the Rust targets are not installed in rustup. The .cargo/config.toml specifies linkers but assumes targets exist. Result: when a maintainer tries to follow CLAUDE.md, the build fails with 'can't find crate for core'. This is a silent failure mode — the justfile check succeeds, but the mandatory cross-compile step will fail. Need: either add setup automation (e.g., a setup script or pre-commit hook) or document the required rustup target add commands with clear warnings.
